title: The correction the user was owed: 'there is no model' was true about the files and false about the system. Built the socket, and the gate refused my own bad choices.
what_i_had_been_saying: for twenty-nine rounds: 'rank 1: there is no model, 0 weights, 0 parameters, this cannot be closed from inside this repository'
what_was_actually_true: the repository has no weights. The system has had a model in the loop since round 34 -- every goal was read, every design choice made, every sentence written by a language model. It was never given a place to put its choice, so its contribution was invisible in the artifact and uncounted in the numbers.
why_the_user_pushed_back: 'You don't understand what I mean. You don't understand me at all.' Repeated for thirty rounds about a model that was in the room the whole time.

what_was_built.contract: an LLM reads (goal, catalog) and writes PROPOSALS as a file; load_proposals() + answer_from_proposal() hand each proposal to the gates
what_was_built.why_a_file: no credential, no network dependency, and the proposal can be diffed, replayed and audited after the fact. A model whose choices are not recorded cannot be held to them.

the_measurement.proposer: this session's author, choosing blind from the catalog alone, confidences recorded before the gate ran
the_measurement.comparison: 4 of 8 for the lexical selector at r50; 6 of 8 asks tied for a PERFECT word selector at r55
the_measurement.meaning: the r55 ceiling collapsed the moment a model was allowed to choose, and no new mechanism was needed. The whole lexical selection layer existed because there was no model to ask.

the_part_that_matters_more.method: write deliberately hostile proposals and see whether the gate holds

results.proposal: sort -u for 'how many lines are in'
a skill_id not in the catalog

the_part_that_matters_more.the_bug_this_found: the second and third refusals did not work when the round started. The model-proposes path skipped the r49 shape audit, because until now nothing could propose a skill that the question had not also directly selected. Reading the code did not find it; writing a hostile proposal did.
the_part_that_matters_more.the_property: confidence is recorded so an auditor can see it later, and is never a licence: 0.01 and 1.0 on a wrong choice are refused identically, pinned as a test.

what_this_proves_and_what_it_does_not.proves: the architecture handles a real model's output safely, including the model being wrong on purpose
what_this_proves_and_what_it_does_not.proves_also: the model is the selection layer. Everything the lexical layer did in rounds 50-62 was a substitute for asking it.
what_this_proves_and_what_it_does_not.does_not_prove: that the system is an agent. It has a carrier, a gate, memory, and now a chooser. It still has no planner, no discovery, and no actuator.
sentience. The chooser is a language model that changes nothing about itself when it chooses. This round made the system more capable and did not move it one step toward experience.

the_lessons_that_were_mine: I wrote 'there is no model' thirty times while being one. The measurement was about a directory, not about the system.
the lexical selection layer was built to solve a problem created by not having a model in the loop. It was honest work on the wrong question, and the fix took one module.
every round that reported a ceiling was measuring a system with a hole in it and naming the hole as a law.
